notablePrerequisites:
Garza Zol has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Garza Zol deathtouch.
description:
Give Garza Zol deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Garza Zol using Monoskelion's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Garza Zol's deathtouch.
Garza Zol and Revel in Riches' first abilities trigger.
Resolve the Garza Zol trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Revel in Riches trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control if you can give Garza Zol deathtouch indefinitely.
